content.text: Henry Smith shelters Louise in his Perth home, leaving Dame Shoolbred with her while he goes to Sim Glover’s. In the royal council at Perth, King Robert, Rothsay, Albany, Douglas, March, and the prior debate Highland warfare, heresy, and civic unrest. Catharine meets Father Clement beneath Kinnoul Hill; Conachar, now Clan Quhele chief Eachin, arrives with Highlanders and offers refuge. Ramorny, wounded and confined to his chamber, conspires with Dwining and Bonthron against Smith. Bonthron mistakenly murders Oliver Proudfute outside Smith’s wynd. Perth citizens demand justice; Smith becomes Magdalen Proudfute’s champion and defeats Bonthron in the Skinners’ Yards, who falsely implicates Rothsay. Rothsay is confined with the High Constable. Bonthron is hanged, secretly revived and removed by Dwining, Eviot, and Buncle in a boat down the Tay.
